facts: Parties: Eskdale Marine Ltd (Buyer), Yarrow Marine Ltd (Seller); the Company is Thornbury Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 29 December 2026; Closing is scheduled for 31 March 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,100,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $3,500,000.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Fenwick Medical Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $2,590,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $108,180,000.
